biggest_catch: Bonus pays only around day 91-97 after opening, the account must stay open with a balance of at least $0.01, and membership is restricted to 18 Florida counties.
catches: Membership is restricted to people who live, work, or attend school in 18 Florida counties (Baker, Brevard, Broward, Clay, Duval, Flagler, Indian River, Lake, Martin, Nassau, Orange, Palm Beach, Putnam, Seminole, St. Johns, St. Lucie, Volusia), relatives of eligible members, and select employer groups.
New members must open a share savings account with a $5 initial deposit to establish membership.
Deposits totaling $1,000 or more must post within the first 90 days of account opening; 10 or more qualifying debit card transactions must also post within 90 days.
Not available to anyone who currently has or previously had a checking account with Community First Credit Union.
Bonus is credited only on or around day 91-97 of account opening — roughly 3 months after opening.

The account must remain open and in good standing with a balance greater than or equal to $0.01 until the bonus is deposited; reward is forfeited if the account is closed early or has a negative available balance at qualification validation.
Online applicants must use code FREECHECK; in-person applicants must mention the offer at account opening to be eligible.
Promotion applies once per checking account and once per member; cannot be combined with other offers.
All offers may end at any time without notice.
Official terms page carries no explicit IRS/tax reporting language for the bonus.

Must not currently have or have previously had a Community First checking account. Accounts subject to approval.

steps: Confirm eligibility for Community First CU membership (live, work, or attend school in one of the 18 listed Florida counties, or be a relative of an eligible member).
Open a share savings account with a $5 initial deposit and open your first Community First checking account online using promo code FREECHECK (or mention the offer in person).
Within the first 90 days of account opening, complete deposits totaling $1,000 or more that post to the account.
Within the first 90 days of account opening, make 10 or more qualifying debit card transactions that post to the account.
Keep the account open and in good standing with a balance of at least $0.01; the $200 bonus is credited on or around day 91-97 of account opening.
timing: Bonus credited on or around day 91-97 of account opening. Qualifying deposits ($1,000+) and 10+ debit-card transactions must post within the first 90 days of account opening.
